item.title: Your Voice Helps Shape Wellbeing at RPI
item.description: Take the confidential Student Wellbeing Survey to help us understand your overall holistic wellbeing and the support you need. Survey is open from Thursday, October 15 through Friday, November 20.

item.title: National First-Generation Student Week | November 2nd-6th, 2026
item.description: The Office of Inclusive Excellence (O.I.E.) is happy to announce this year’s National First-Gen Week events being held Monday, November 02 through Friday, November 06! This week is about campus events that empower first-generation students to learn about what resources are available as well as connecting with fellow first-generation students, faculty, and staff!

item.title: Meet IBM THIS FRIDAY, Oct 23: hosted by RPI IISE
item.description: Date: Friday, October 23, 2026 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM - RPI’s IISE Student Chapter is excited to announce an event with IBM hosted by an RPI alum, Valerie Bubel, THIS FRIDAY, October 23rd, Located in CII 3206, from 4-5PM. Please join us to learn more about IBM and to find out what opportunities they might offer for you! Hope to see you all there! ??

item.title: Honors Convocation 2026
item.description: Date: Saturday, October 24, 2026 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM - Honors Convocation is an invitation-only ceremony celebrating exceptional academic achievement and outstanding contributions by RPI students and faculty. The event recognizes recipients of prestigious awards, scholarships, and academic honors while reaffirming the Institute’s commitment to excellence, scholarship, and leadership. Family members and invited guests join the RPI community in honoring this year’s award recipients.

item.title: RPI Symphony Orchestra, Concert Choir, and Wind Symphony Family Weekend Concert
item.description: Celebrate Family Weekend with an afternoon of outstanding music presented by the RPI Symphony Orchestra, Concert Choir, and Wind Symphony. This exciting program features a dynamic mix of choral, wind, and orchestral works, from inspiring spirituals and majestic classics to vibrant contemporary favorites. Join us October 24, 4-5:30pm in DCC 308.

item.description: Join International Services for Students and Scholars (ISSS) to talk about current updates related to CPT & D/S. Come hear about what changes are happening, and how ISSS can support international students. Bring your questions! Wednesday, October 21 at 10:00 AM ( Virtual - register at: https://tinyurl.com/RPI-townhall-102126 ) and Thursday, October 22 at 4:30 PM (In-person at CBIS Auditorium, ID card required to access building)

item.title: Microplastics Exhibit at Context Collective (95 4th Street, Troy)
item.description: Friday, October 23, 6-9 pm. Artist Nicole Chockrek has been collecting plastic from the environment since 2022. This installation will bring together over 30,000 pieces of plastic collected through Microplastic recycling bins (including one in Troy). Over 50 RPI faculty and students have contributed to this installation by making a microplastic mosaic. Come find your contribution, or contribute yourself!

item.title: Handshake Training for Faculty & Staff
item.description: Are you hiring students for the spring semester? The Center for Career & Professional Development (CCPD) will host a virtual training for faculty and staff interested in posting their on-campus job or research opportunities in Handshake. The training will take place on Wednesday, November 4th from 11-11:45am. Learn about the job board system, writing strong postings, and see a demo of the platform. If you are interested in attending or have questions, please email Nicole Doran at stongn@rpi.edu.

item.title: RPI Faculty and Staff In Person Workshop - Deeper Dive into the Active Learning Approaches of Jigsaw, Think/Pair/Share, & Visual Maps
item.description: Date: Monday, November 2, 2026 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM - In this workshop, we will focus on the three active learning concepts of the Jigsaw activity, Think/Pair/Share and working with Visual Maps/Charts. We will spend some time on each of these three approaches, discussing the concept of each and looking at examples to help you think about how you might be able to incorporate the approach into your class as an activity. item.description:
